page: Microsoft Azure FX24mds_v2 is a memory-intensive virtual machine belonging to the FXmdsv2 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 12 physical Intel Xeon 8573C cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a base frequency of 4.2 GHz. The processor includes a 260 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for tile and INT8 operations. The system is equipped with 504.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 21.0 GB per vCPU. Local storage is provided via a bundled 1417 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark results highlight strong single-core and memory-bound performance. The server achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 2367.0, placing it in the top tier, alongside high-ranking results in image processing and text processing. Single-threaded gzip compression reaches 34.92 GB/sec, and single-threaded bzip3 decompression performs at 14.34 GB/sec. Multi-core performance is also robust, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 17385.0 and a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 26660.04. For memory performance, the instance delivers a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 2070.94 GB/sec, while large-block uncached read and write bandwidths reach 166.75 GB/sec and 79.11 GB/sec, respectively.

With its combination of high-frequency dedicated Intel Xeon cores, massive memory capacity, and fast local NVMe SSD storage, the FX24mds_v2 is highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring high resource density and rapid memory access without the overhead of a GPU. It is well-suited for large-scale in-memory databases, heavy data processing, software compilation, and text or image processing pipelines. Additionally, the presence of Intel AMX instructions enables efficient CPU-based machine learning tasks, as demonstrated by a top-tier text generation speed of 408.05 tokens/sec for small 135M LLM models and a prompt processing speed of 170.31 tokens/sec for medium 7B models.
